entries.title: Pendulum Rhythm Grid
entries.description: A 3D grid of pendulums with slightly different lengths swings over a light plane, gradually shifting from synchronized motion to complex phase patterns, with trails showing their arcs and color-changing bobs indicating local rhythm clusters.

entries.title: Orbital Beat Planets
